visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses and a black baseball cap is walking outdoors on a bustling urban street. He is wearing a black T-shirt with a red graphic. He looks directly into the camera lens, speaking with animated facial expressions while moving through a sidewalk area. (2) The scene cuts to include a woman wearing a pink cap and glasses. She holds a small, white, cylindrical portable fan. They stand together on the sidewalk in front of storefronts. Animated graphics of a small fan and fire appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) The woman demonstrates the fan, pointing it toward her neck. The camera captures her smiling and gesturing toward the device. The background shows parked scooters and shop signs. (4) The man interacts with the woman as she points the fan toward his face. He reacts with a look of surprise and relief from the heat. They are positioned in a semi-shaded area of the street with natural daylight. (5) Both individuals pose for the camera; the man points toward the portable fan while the woman holds it up. They are smiling, and the video concludes with a direct appeal to the viewer.
